relevance_note: One of four cases in this imaging case series has GAMT deficiency: "Genetic testing identified a homozygous mutation in the guanidinoacetate methyltransferase (GAMT) gene".
method_note: Read by hand; no table transcription. Four-case series of different neurometabolic disorders; only Case 3 is in scope (Cases 1, 2 and 4 have SLC25A19, SLC19A3 and SLC39A14 variants and get no rows; cohort_size_as_stated = 4). Label 'Case 3' from the case heading (the Discussion writes 'case 3'). Sex not stated ('child'). The only age is 'a four-year-old child presenting with developmental delay', recorded as age at last evaluation (age at presentation/report); onset and diagnosis ages not stated. The GAMT variant is described only as 'a homozygous mutation ... particularly within intron 2', so variant_original_string is 'not reported' and variant_type is not reported (no class stated). is_proband left null: case series, no proband/index wording. Treatment from the Discussion sentence 'In this study, ... initiating treatment with oral creatine monohydrate', read as this paper's GAMT case. Central tegmental tract T2 hyperintensities recorded as observed for the 'white matter or brainstem signal abnormalities on mri' checklist item (a brainstem tract; the paper does not use the word brainstem). No contradictions found.
